ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which labeled part of the diagram represents the cell membrane?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This figure is a schematic diagram of an animal cell; the cell shape is surrounded by a thin external boundary, with multiple letter labels and leader lines around it. The leader line of label J points to the thin outer edge on the left side of the cell. Reasoning: The question asks which labeled part represents the cell membrane. The cell membrane is the outermost layer of an animal cell, the thin boundary surrounding the whole cell. Since J points to this external boundary, the label corresponding to the cell membrane is J.
